title: Harness issues found and fixed during the desktop run (test-only)
environment: loopback-devnet-artifact (real devnet, Firestore devnet namespace, R2 devnet/), browser = installed Chrome 154 desktop 1280x900, wallet = Pocket QA Test Wallet (devnet): injected by Playwright, not an extension

steps: Attempts and segments on 2026-10-06/07, all under the lead's GO.
observed: (1) Attempt #1 23:50:52Z: the scratch dir under /private/tmp had been removed by the disk cleanup -> the shell failed on the output redirect; Playwright never started. (2) Attempt #2 23:51:27Z: the cleanup also removed ~/Library/Caches/ms-playwright -> no browser; re-downloading would be an install -> switched the hosted projects to the installed Google Chrome 154 (535a6f5). (3) Attempt #3 23:52:04Z: STOPPED on the tester's unexpected existing link 2bV3... (no change made). (4) Segment 2: a bare getByText(title) matched twice on the Discover card; the strict-mode error was swallowed by the wait as 'not visible' -> .first() (f78a74d). (5) Segment 1 was stopped by the parent's override; killed by exact PIDs, a zsh word-splitting slip meant the first kill hit only the parent shells (the rest exited with them, verified PID by PID). In every case the chain was inspected before any retry: nothing signed except the WD-03 funding.
notes: Evidence is copied from the gitignored apps/mobile/test-results/hosted-devnet (no secrets, no presigned URLs: query strings are dropped by the recorder).
